sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate is semantically faithful and deterministic validation is valid. It targets the ship, includes the required iceClass and maximumContinuousRatingPower inputs with the canonical range and kW unit, correctly scopes the owner-request alternatives to the 1 November 1986 through 1 September 2003 cohort, requires explicit selector evidence, and enforces the 1985 applicable edition and the conditional engine-output edition with single-value constraints.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS

Deterministic validation prevents acceptance. Fix: COMPLETE dependency relationship(s) absent from candidate: iceClass
Semantic validator feedback: Repair the candidate by encoding the complete required iceClass relationship on the ship, as reported by the COMPLETE dependency contract: add a ship-level nltl:iceClass property constraint with at least one value and the canonical nltl:iceClassValue range (and enforce the appropriate single relationship if the RDF model permits only one). Also tighten the edition relationships so applicableIceClassRegulationEdition and engineOutputRegulationEdition cannot contain extra conflicting values alongside the required controlled edition; preserve the existing date applicability and owner-request branching.

Repair the applicability logic: the owner-requested 2008 branch is currently independent of the construction-stage cohort, so a non-cohort ship with ownerRequested2008EngineOutputRequirements=true is incorrectly required to use iceClassRegulationEdition2008. Nest the owner-request alternative under the applicable construction cohort, or otherwise constrain the 2008 selector to that cohort; preserve the existing 1985 edition requirement for the cohort and the complete ship-level iceClass relationship.

The candidate still omits the declared required input mcrPower_kW, represented by the canonical ship-level nltl:maximumContinuousRatingPower property. Add a required ship-level constraint for nltl:maximumContinuousRatingPower with its canonical QuantityValue range and kW unit representation, while preserving the existing iceClass relationship and cohort-scoped edition branching.

The candidate is semantically faithful and deterministic validation is valid. It targets the ship, includes the required iceClass and maximumContinuousRatingPower inputs with the canonical range and kW unit, correctly scopes the owner-request alternatives to the 1 November 1986 through 1 September 2003 cohort, requires explicit selector evidence, and enforces the 1985 applicable edition and the conditional engine-output edition with single-value constraints.
